verdict.rationale: The skills live in a public GitHub repository. The docs describe validating an unpublished checkout through a local marketplace path, and a Nix flake builds the portable plugin layout, so users can run the skill pack from their own copy without a vendor-hosted service. However, the skills depend on the `yy` CLI and YYLO Ledger, and nothing shows those backing components can be self-hosted. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license, self-hosting docs for the YYLO CLI/Ledger backend the skills rely on, and independent hands-on confirmation of a fully self-hosted setup.
